claim_boundary: This 16-prompt suite was selected during development. Results are causal debugging evidence, not a final benchmark table.

development_decision.claim_boundary: Passing only permits the next development experiment. It does not promote a paper method or establish statistical superiority.
development_decision.rule: Both order-balanced lanes must be nonnegative on Quality, identity/background, temporal mechanics and dynamic degree; matched means must also be nonnegative; Quality effect must exceed mean same-policy replica noise; mechanism must pass.
